provenance.method: Bounded review of National Autistic Society guidance on asking for reasonable adjustments when seeking mental-health help; legal wording is not generalized across jurisdictions.

name: National Autistic Society — mental-health reasonable adjustments
description: Practical autism-specific guide to discussing communication, sensory, session-format and other adjustments with mental-health services.
intended_use: Preparing concrete access requests for therapy or mental-health appointments when standard delivery creates barriers.
audience_or_context: Autistic people and supporters; legal entitlement details vary by UK jurisdiction and service context.
limitations: The guide does not make any particular adjustment automatically reasonable or available in every service.
Treatment decisions and crisis assessment remain clinical responsibilities.
